competing_hypotheses: Live tokenization can increase institutional XRPL utility and credibility.
Fund-share investment does not equal XRP demand; the investment is in the share class and the underlying assets remain within conventional fund arrangements.
Announcement attention may affect narratives without persistent on-ledger activity or measurable XRP price impact.
